title: SBI Life denies report of talks to buy Star Health stake
body: SBI Life Insurance Company has denied a media report that it is in talks to acquire a 26% stake in Star Health and Allied Insurance Company. In a filing to the exchanges on 12 January 2026, SBI Life said the report is factually incorrect and that it has not entered into any discussion with Star Health or its promoters. Shares of Star Health fell 3% during the session.
